_doc: Rulebook coaching tip bank. The LLM does NOT free-generate coaching; it only stitches the sentences SELECTED from this bank into one natural paragraph. With the LLM off/unavailable, the selected sentences are emitted verbatim (deterministic fallback). Selection key = stroke -> axis -> criterion/star -> severity. Consumed by scripts/rulebook.py (server) and flutter_app/lib/rulebook_tips.dart (offline). Mirror copy bundled at flutter_app/assets/rulebook_tips.json.
_provenance: v1 sentences from data/coaching_knowledge.json (Session B); v2 variants + speed/step from scripts/gen_rulebook_tips.py (Session C). Each bucket is a LIST of interchangeable phrasings; selection picks ONE per cell (seeded by clip) so two variants never co-occur.
severity_doc: Posture criteria use severity buckets {pass, minor_fail, major_fail, na}. severity(c)= 'na' if measurement/pass is null; 'pass' if c.pass; 'major_fail' if c.probability < 0.30; else 'minor_fail'. Speed/step axes are keyed by star '1'..'5' (3 = average). Each bucket is a LIST of phrasings; selection takes index 0 for determinism, extra variants exist for future rotation / LLM material.
na_default: 이 항목은 관절이 잘 안 보여서 측정하지 못했어요. 옆에서 전신이 한 화면에 나오게 다시 촬영하면 평가할 수 있어요.
all_good_default: 전반적으로 안정적인 자세예요. 지금 폼을 그대로 유지하세요.

high_clear.note: Overhead clear — full kinetic chain. Power IS the goal; no forbidden power words.

short_serve.note: Short serve is a controlled, slow stroke; BWF rules require feet stationary. Never advise more power/speed/footwork — only control, precision, low/consistent contact. Fixes docs/FUTURE_IMPROVEMENTS.md P1.6 (power-word leakage).

forehand_drive.note: Flat fast exchange. Power/speed allowed, but step/footwork is dropped (split-step is pre-stroke) — never advise more footwork.

unknown_ood.note: Out-of-distribution: no reference distribution for speed/step; posture only, generic wording.
